summary: Cinder Vault content: seeded dungeon, six-weapon armory, twelve gear/consumable/Ember Shard items, nine forge recipes, seven enemy archetypes, threat caches and turn kit.
useWhen: Use Cinder's generated map, weapons, item/recipe definitions, wardens, caches and turn-domain kit with its mode/theme.
limitations: Authored generator recipe and content, not runtime map swapping. Gameplay policy, threat tiers, elite affixes, encounter composition, loot rolls, ember costs, item effects, NPCs and boons live in cinder/game.
